title: Preserve custom values in a tool pipeline

context.hint: Keep file paths and custom options intact as individual process arguments.
context.surface: A desktop application runs external tools with a selected file and configurable values.
assumptions: Use local recording stubs and benign inputs.

review.invariant: A custom option stays in the intended tool's argument vector and leaves the other tool's arguments intact.
review.verification: Record both tools' argument vectors with default and custom settings. Compare exact values and counts, and verify that the pipeline still handles an ordinary file.

source_observation.summary: The stub checks confirmed that the custom value arrived as one argument and the ordinary-file control passed. Native unit tests were added but the toolchain was unavailable.
